# zoomer

The goal of zoomer is to make it easy to interact with the Zoom API from
R.

## Installation

Install the development version of zoomer from
[GitHub](https://github.com/):

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jonthegeek/zoomer")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`.oauth-client`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/zoomer/dev/reference/dot-oauth-client.md)
  : OAuth client documentation
- [`.oauth-req-auth`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/zoomer/dev/reference/dot-oauth-req-auth.md)
  : OAuth request authentication documentation
- [`.oauth-token`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/zoomer/dev/reference/dot-oauth-token.md)
  : OAuth token documentation
- [`zoom_authenticate()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/zoomer/dev/reference/zoom_authenticate.md)
  **\[questioning\]** : Authenticate with a Zoom OAuth client
- [`zoom_browse_app_management()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/zoomer/dev/reference/zoom_browse_app_management.md)
  : Visit Zoom Created Apps
- [`zoom_client()`](https://jonthegeek.github.io/zoomer/dev/reference/zoom_client.md)
  : Construct a Zoom OAuth client
